description: Clear the session-selected vault so the precedence chain falls back to OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH. Use this to signal 'I'm done with the scratch vault, go back to the default'. Idempotent — running on an already-cleared session is a no-op that reports `changed: false`. Does not change per-call `vaultPath` behaviour.
name: vault.reset

anyOf.description: A single vault entry returned by `vault.list` and `vault.current.active`.

exists.description: Whether the path exists on disk at discovery time. `false` flags stale obsidian.json entries (deleted vaults).

id.description: Stable identifier. `obsidian-app` sources use the 16-char hex id Obsidian assigns; `env-named` uses `env:<name>`; `env-default` uses `default`.

isActive.description: True if this vault is the currently session-selected vault.

isDefault.description: True if this vault matches OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH set at server startup.

lastOpened.description: ISO timestamp of when the user last opened this vault in Obsidian. Only present for `obsidian-app` sources.

name.description: Human-readable label. `obsidian-app` + `env-default` sources derive from `path.basename`; `env-named` uses the env-var suffix lowercased.

path.description: Absolute path to the vault directory.

source.description: Where kObsidian learned about this vault. `env-default` = OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH; `env-named` = an OBSIDIAN_VAULT_<NAME>=path env var; `obsidian-app` = parsed from the user's local Obsidian application config (obsidian.json).

title: Reset Active Vault Selection
